commit 34d01ebe9f45172bcd16822a2124ae79a2dc22ec
Date: Thu Jul 19 18:38:03 2012 -0500

Updater: prefer the update site's current versions to locally-cached ones

A rather embarrassing bug entered the ImageJ Updater which prevents
it from updating components because local db.xml.gz's versions are
preferred over those from the update site.

diff --git a/core/updater/core/src/main/java/imagej/updater/core/XMLFileReader.java b/core/updater/core/src/main/java/imagej/updater/core/XMLFileReader.java
ind...

result.reasoning: This commit introduced the `filesFromThisSite` field/set used to track files belonging to the current update site, used to decide shadowing/overriding logic. However, it never cleared this set at the start of processing a new update site (in the `read()` method), so state persisted across multiple calls to read() for different update sites, causing incorrect shadowing behavior. The fix commit simply adds `filesFromThisSite.clear();` at the start of `read()`, directly correcting the omission in this commit.
